business_problem: Changsha Bank needed better digital customer reach, manager tooling, collaboration, geographic planning, and online-security controls as it expanded retail banking and reached more county and community markets.
solution_summary: Changsha Bank worked with Tencent Cloud to redesign retail customer acquisition, service, and internal collaboration around the WeChat ecosystem rather than branch-only workflows. The program combines WeChat and Enterprise WeChat touchpoints, AI, online audio/video services, live streaming, Tencent Meeting, geospatial data, mini-program security, and anti-fraud controls. Tencent and the bank also co-developed a "Changsha Financial Ecology Map" that uses location data and retail-marketing models to guide branch planning, campaign execution, and manager resource allocation. These shared services support customer-manager outreach, remote service, internal collaboration, and compliant online financial journeys in one operating model. Security services protect the retail workflow while digital marketing tools let the bank build a private-domain traffic pool and contact customers continuously. The implementation turns service, planning, and risk control into a coordinated retail platform.

data_flow: Customer interactions from WeChat, Enterprise WeChat, live streaming, meetings, and mini programs feed the bank's digital-retail operating model; geospatial and marketing-model data shape the Financial Ecology Map, while security and anti-fraud controls protect the full online-service loop.
business_outcome: Changsha Bank gained a more scalable customer-acquisition and service model, stronger manager productivity, more precise planning and resource allocation, and safer online retail-finance operations.
